historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization, as modified, for development of a site larger than 9,999 square feet with a use larger than 5,999 square feet and housing with fewer than 25-percent affordable units, 4-3.
An existing grocery store and public parking lot stood on the site.

The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved, as modified, the change of use from a grocery store and public parking lot to a grocery store, laundry, and apartment building, 4-3.
